chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bakhtarī, from the one who mentioned it, from Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام), who said:

When my father, ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn (عليه السلام), passed away, a she-camel of his came from the pasture until she struck her neck upon the grave and rolled upon it. So I ordered concerning her, and she was returned to her pasture. My father (عليه السلام) used to perform hajj upon her and perform ʿumrah, and he had never struck her even a single strike at all.

key_terms.الرَّعْيِ: pasture or grazing place from which the animal came
key_terms.الْقَبْرِ: the grave of Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn (عليه السلام)
key_terms.نَاقَةٌ: a she-camel belonging to the Imam

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the she-camel of Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn (عليه السلام) after his death?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates an incident after the death of Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn (عليه السلام), when his she-camel came to his grave and displayed a striking reaction. It also highlights his gentle conduct toward the animal, noting that he used her for hajj and ʿumrah yet never struck her.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim Bin Hashim, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Hafs Bin Al Bakhtary, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> passed away, a she-camel of his<sup>asws</sup> came over from the pen until she struck herself upon the side of the grave and wallowed upon it. So I<sup>asws</sup> ordered with her, and she was returned to her pen, and that my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> had performed Hajj and Umrah upon her, and he<sup>asws</sup> had not whipped it with a whip at all’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn al-Faddal from ibn Bukayr from Zurara who has said the following. “I heard abu Ja‘far (a.s.) say,

‘Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.) had a she camel. He had taken this camel twenty two times to Hajj (pilgrimage to Makka) and had not used the whip against not even once. The Imam (a.s.) has said that the camel came after he passed away and we were not aware but we noticed only when one of the servants or slaves came and said, “The she camel has went out all the way to the grave of Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.) and sat on the grave. She rubs her neck against the grave and moans. I then asked them to quickly get to her before they would know about her or see her. The Imam (a.s.) has said, “She had never seen the grave before.”
